Cards.Name: Disreputable Deal
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect, you may put a non-Unique Strategy with a Political ability in your discard pile into your hand.
Political Open: Bow your target performing Courtier to give a target Personality -3F. If he is dishonorable, his controller loses Honor equal to his printed Personal Honor.

Cards.Name: Engulfing Flames
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Monk: You may target and destroy an enemy attachment. If your Monk has any Fire tokens, Ranged 4 Attack.
